name: Ice
description: Guidelines for traveling with ice in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Ice and frozen gel packs must be frozen completely solid when passing security. If they are partially melted or slushy, 3-1-1 liquid limits apply.

checkedBag.reason: Ice and gel packs are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring ice on a plane?

travelTips: Ice and frozen gel packs must be frozen completely solid when passing security. If they are partially melted or slushy, 3-1-1 liquid limits apply.

faq.question: Is ice allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Ice is restricted in carry-on luggage. Ice and frozen gel packs must be frozen completely solid when passing security. If they are partially melted or slushy, 3-1-1 liquid limits apply.

faq.question: Can you pack ice in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Ice is allowed in checked bags. Ice and gel packs are allowed in checked baggage.
